csv_scope_of_work: The purpose of this Request for Proposals (RFP) is to obtain services from a qualified firm to provide consulting services for roof evaluation, roof installation and repair observation and roof construction contract administration services for existing and new installations in Chesterfield County and Chesterfield County Public Schools (herein referred to collectively as the County ). General Requirements The Successful Offeror should provide: Page 4 of 61 1. Roof inspections. 2. Moisture intrusion surveys. 3. Core sampling and asbestos testing. 4. Roof system condition evaluations. 5. Roof repair and replacement design documents. 6. Budgetary cost estimating. 7. Bidding services. 8. Construction administration. 9. Quality control inspections. 10.Roof system maintenance training. 11.Warranty claim assistance. 12.Forensic investigation and expert witness services
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Landscape Architecture, Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Cost Estimating, Inspection Services, Asbestos/Lead Abatement, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering
